comment: Pinned upstream sources for the layer 1-3 validation scripts. Every pin is content-addressed by sha256 in upstream_lock.json; with an intact .cache/ + lock, fetch_upstream.py performs NO network access. Update a pin by editing the url here and running `python3 lib/fetch_upstream.py --update-lock` (never by guessing a new path inside a check script — a 404 fails the fetch with the URL).

hermes_plugins_py.note: Hermes plugin facade at pinned commit (main, 2026-11-08); re-exports PluginContext and the manifest, references VALID_HOOKS.

hermes_hooks_py.note: Defines the valid hook names; must contain "pre_tool_call".

nc_openapi_v34.note: Nextcloud server OCS OpenAPI spec at the support floor tag v34.0.5 (latest stable v34 at pin time).

nc_openapi_v35.note: Nextcloud server OCS OpenAPI spec at the latest stable tag v35.0.2 (no v36 stable tag exists at pin time; confirmed via the tags API).

nc_releases.note: GitHub releases feed for nextcloud/server; used for the floor->latest deprecation sweep.

docs_v34_webdav_basic.note: WebDAV basics (files root, multistatus semantics), floor docs.

docs_v34_activity_api.note: Activity API page; pinned at stable35 (identical path exists at stable34).

talk_openapi_v25.note: Talk (spreed) app OpenAPI spec at tag v25.0.7 — covers /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/... (the server spec excludes app endpoints).

talk_docs_conversation.note: Talk docs page referencing apps/spreed/api/v4 room endpoints.

notes_docs_v6.note: Notes app API v1 doc — covers /index.php/apps/notes/api/v1/notes.

rfc4918_webdav.note: RFC 4918 (WebDAV) text — 10 multistatus examples incl. per-propstat HTTP/1.1 200/403/412 statuses. sabre/dav test files were dropped as fixture sources: their tests xpath into server-generated XML instead of embedding multistatus literals (verified at tag 4.7.1), so the pinned docs + RFC are the upstream XML fixtures.

meta.note: Scratch-venv pins for layer 2 (validate_all.sh creates scripts/.venv-check/, gitignored). openapi-spec-validator 0.9.0 conflicts with openapi-core 0.23.1 (which requires osv <0.9.0), so the pair is 0.8.5 (exports OpenAPIV32SpecValidator) + 0.23.1; both support Python >=3.10. Runtime deps stay httpx-only; tests stay httpx+pytest.
